data.name: Qwerty Garden
data.detailed_description:
🌸 Qwerty Garden

Turn every keystroke into something beautiful.

Qwerty Garden is a cozy typing game where your keyboard becomes a living flower bed. Each key from A to Z is a patch of soil, and every letter you type makes a flower grow.

Relax, type, and watch your garden bloom.

🌱 How It Works

Every key press feeds a flower. When a flower finishes growing, it’s harvested automatically and added to your inventory.
Sell your flowers to earn money, then reinvest it into your garden by buying new seeds that grow rarer, more valuable blooms.

The more you type, the more your garden thrives.

🌼 Grow. Sell. Upgrade. Repeat.

The core loop is simple and satisfying:

Type to Grow Flowers → Sell the Collected Flowers → Buy Better Seeds

Start with humble plants.
Unlock exotic, high-value flowers.
Fill your keyboard with brilliant colors and rising profits.

Your garden slowly transforms from a few simple sprouts into a glowing, profitable flower empire.

✨ Prestige for Power

When you’ve built a thriving garden, you can Prestige.

Prestiging resets your garden — but in return, every flower you grow from then on produces extra harvests. Each Prestige makes your future gardens stronger, faster, and more rewarding.

Build bigger. Reset smarter. Grow exponentially.

🌻 Why You’ll Love It

  • A relaxing, cozy twist on typing games

  • Satisfying incremental progression

  • Every key on your keyboard becomes part of the game

  • Perfect for multitasking, practicing typing, or just unwinding

  • Infinite replayability through prestige and upgrades

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
